sources: recreation.gov search API: 'Jumping Creek Campground' (242553) is listed as not reservable, with no campground record, read 2026-10-22

values.note: $15 a night per single site, paid at the self-serve fee station; fees still required when water is off.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/jumping-creek-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'Please pay at the self-serve campground fee station', Current Conditions 'No potable water available. Fees still required.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Several slots take long trailers, to 45 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/jumping-creek-campground ('The 10 campsites are along Sheep Creek', 'The campground has multiple slots which can accommodate long trailers, up to a maximum length of 45 feet'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water is offered in the warmer months, but the current conditions (October 2026) say 'No potable water available', while the amenity list says potable water is available.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/jumping-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'all have at least one handicap accessible vault toilet', Current Conditions 'No potable water available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'usually open late May through October.' Open and close dates vary with snowfall.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/jumping-creek-campground ('Jumping Creek Campground is usually open late May through October', 'Open and close dates can vary depending on snowfall conditions'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: All Helena-Lewis and Clark NF campgrounds are first-come, first-served; the camper must be present (paying does not hold a site).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/jumping-creek-campground ('All campgrounds on the Helena-Lewis and Clark National Forest are first-come, first-served. Reservations are not available. Camping is limited to 16 consecutive days in one location.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Helena-Lewis and Clark NF campground along Sheep Creek (brook and rainbow trout) on US 89 in the Little Belt Mountains, ~22 mi N of White Sulphur Springs (17 mi S of Neihart) at ~5,800 ft. Historic logging roads nearby give motorized access to the Smoky Mountain area; a scenic ATV trail up Mizpah Peak starts east on US 89. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run, first-come first-served (all H-LC NF campgrounds). Confirmed $15 (2026), 10 sites, 45-ft slots, vault toilets, FCFS/not reservable; added 16-day limit and season wording (usually late May - October). No electric (hookups left derived; the page does not list hookups). Potable water left unset: the page contradicts itself. Note trimmed of restated values.
